# `aitbc edge metrics list-metrics`

List edge metrics, optionally filtered by GPU.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc edge metrics list-metrics [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--gpu-id` | text | — | no | Filter by GPU ID |
| `--limit` | integer | `100` | no | Number of metrics to return |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc edge metrics list-metrics
```
